solutionSource.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

entries.clue: Steered straight for Spooner’s warning sign (3,5)

indicatorNotes.Spooner’s: Reverend Spooner swapped the opening sounds of words, so his version of a phrase trades its initial sounds

blocks.note: steered = led, which takes the R sound from the next word
straight = right, which takes the L sound from the first word

annotation.surface: A driver who kept going straight and ended up at a warning sign.
annotation.walkthrough: The unswapped phrase means guided straight on; exchanging its first sounds gives the traffic signal, which fits the driving surface.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym by example: a stop signal at traffic lights is the classic warning sign.

entries.clue: Dodgy tear in tissue (6)

indicatorNotes.Dodgy: something dodgy is unsound, so the letters are not in their proper order

annotation.surface: Someone spots a suspicious rip in a paper handkerchief.
annotation.walkthrough: "Tissue" suggests a paper hankie, but it is the biological sense: layers of cells.
annotation.definitionFit: A definition by example: the light-sensitive layer at the back of the eye is one kind of tissue.

entries.clue: Back in outskirts of Derby, it’s dull (6)

indicatorNotes.in: the first piece sits inside the second
indicatorNotes.outskirts of: outskirts are the edges, so take only the first and last letters of Derby

blocks.note: first and last letters of Derby
the back of something is its rear

annotation.surface: A returning visitor finds the edge of Derby a dull place.
annotation.walkthrough: Derby is a city in the English Midlands; "Back" reads as returning, but it is the noun for the hind part.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: gloomy and tedious, as in a dull, grey day.

entries.clue: I start to gentrify small room in house (5)

indicatorNotes.start to: the start of a word is its first letter

blocks.note: a loo is a toilet, a small room

annotation.surface: A homeowner announces they are starting to smarten up a small room in the house.
annotation.walkthrough: A loo is everyday British for a toilet; "house" is the definition, not where the room is.
annotation.definitionFit: A definition by example: a dome of snow blocks built by Inuit people is a kind of house.

entries.clue: Cleanliness of prominent inherited item remarked upon (7)

indicatorNotes.remarked upon: something remarked upon is spoken, so the answer is how the phrase sounds

annotation.surface: Someone comments on the tidiness of a notable family heirloom.
annotation.walkthrough: "Inherited item" suggests an heirloom, but it is a gene, the unit of heredity.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: the practice of keeping clean to stay healthy.

entries.clue: Some Tabasco used for northern stew (6)

indicatorNotes.Some: only some of the letters of the following words are used

blocks.note: the last three letters of Tabasco run into the first four of used

annotation.surface: A cook adds a dash of hot sauce to a hearty northern stew.
annotation.walkthrough: The answer sits inside taba-SCO USE-d. It is the lamb or beef stew of Liverpool, in the north of England, which gave Liverpudlians their nickname.
annotation.definitionFit: A regional dish: Liverpool's stew of meat, potatoes and vegetables.

entries.clue: Numbed nerve that might be pointed out on chart (4,5)

annotation.definition: that might be pointed out on chart

blocks.note: front is cheek or nerve, as in 'had the front to ask'

annotation.surface: A doctor points out a deadened nerve on a medical chart.
annotation.walkthrough: The chart is a weather map, where this boundary is drawn as a line with pointed triangles along it, so it is literally pointed out.
annotation.definitionFit: A cryptic description: weather charts mark advancing cold air with a line of triangular points.

entries.clue: Half of amount stopped: not well managed (8)

indicatorNotes.Half of: take one half of the word that follows

blocks.note: the last three of amount's six letters

annotation.surface: A payment halted halfway because the accounts were badly run.
annotation.walkthrough: Take the back half of amount, not the front AMO.
annotation.definitionFit: A loose synonym: left uncared for, as a neglected garden is not looked after or managed.

entries.clue: Desires uncapped income (8)

indicatorNotes.uncapped: without its cap, meaning its top letter; in a down answer the first letter is the top

blocks.note: desires = yearnings; uncapped drops the first letter

annotation.surface: People want an income with no upper limit.
annotation.walkthrough: "Uncapped income" reads as salary with no ceiling, but uncapped acts on desires, losing its Y.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: the money someone is paid for work.

entries.clue: Those people including old record in religious study (8)

indicatorNotes.including: the first piece takes the second inside it

blocks.note: a log is a written record

annotation.surface: A group consulting an ancient record during their religious research.
annotation.walkthrough: "Record" suggests a vinyl disc beside "old", but here it is a written account, like a ship's log.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: the academic study of God and religious belief.

entries.clue: Roofer behind time after second run (6)

indicatorNotes.after: the piece for 'behind time' comes after the S

blocks.note: cricket scoring abbreviation for a run

annotation.surface: A roofer arrives late, a second time running.
annotation.walkthrough: The pieces are not in clue order: 'after' puts S first, and R follows.
annotation.definitionFit: A specific kind of roofer: one who lays slates.

entries.clue: Small label for animal (4)

annotation.surface: A little ear tag clipped on livestock.
annotation.walkthrough: "Animal" is a very broad definition, so the wordplay does all the work here.
annotation.definitionFit: A definition by example: a male deer is one animal among many.

entries.clue: Most limited and now rarest supply (9)

indicatorNotes.supply: read as the adverb of supple: bendily, so the letters flex into a new order

annotation.surface: A shop notes that the scarcest stock is now also in the shortest supply.
annotation.walkthrough: "Supply" looks like a noun about stock; it is SUPPLE + -LY, meaning pliably, the anagram signal.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym in the superlative: most restricted in scope or width.

entries.clue: Mushrooms enjoyable with good sushi ultimately (5)

indicatorNotes.ultimately: take the ultimate, meaning last, letter

annotation.surface: Someone praises the mushrooms served with sushi.
annotation.walkthrough: The surface reads as a restaurant review, with good sushi; here good is only its abbreviation.
annotation.definitionFit: A definition by example the other way round: mushrooms are the best-known members of this kingdom.

entries.clue: Man maybe in tennis lesson (4)

indicatorNotes.in: the answer lies within the following words

blocks.note: the last two letters of tennis and the first two of lesson

annotation.surface: A man, perhaps, taking a tennis lesson.
annotation.walkthrough: "Man" is not a person but the Isle of Man, an island between Britain and Ireland; 'maybe' marks it as one example.
annotation.definitionFit: A definition by example: Man is an island in the Irish Sea, so it stands for any island.

entries.clue: Moves around important parts for computer user (5,4)

annotation.definitionNote: a descriptive definition: things for a computer user

blocks.note: to shift is to move things around
the key parts are the important ones

annotation.surface: Someone rearranges the vital components on behalf of a computer user.
annotation.walkthrough: The phrase reads as office rearranging, but the answer is the keyboard buttons a typist presses for capitals.
annotation.definitionFit: A descriptive definition: keyboard buttons that anyone typing on a computer uses.

entries.clue: Nice breakfast for reliable fellow (4,3)

blocks.note: dated slang for a decent chap

annotation.surface: A pleasant breakfast served to a dependable chap.
annotation.walkthrough: The idiom is dated British slang for a decent, trustworthy person.
annotation.definitionFit: Both senses: a literal tasty egg, and an idiom for a kind, dependable person.

entries.clue: That woman in 3-D is like an angel (8)

indicatorNotes.in: the first piece goes inside the second

annotation.surface: A woman seen in a 3-D film looks angelic.
annotation.walkthrough: "3-D" is not a cross-reference to another clue; it means three-dimensional.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: like a cherub, one of the orders of angels, sweet and round-faced.

entries.clue: Is it a rum fancy for dessert? (8)

indicatorNotes.fancy: fancy means elaborately arranged, so the letters are rearranged

annotation.surface: A diner wonders whether an elaborate rum dish counts as pudding.
annotation.walkthrough: This pudding is often soaked in rum or another spirit, which makes the question apt.
annotation.definitionFit: A definition by example: an Italian coffee-soaked sponge and mascarpone pudding.

entries.clue: Calling hospital, feeling unwell (7)

annotation.surface: Someone phoning the hospital because they feel ill.
annotation.walkthrough: Calling reads as telephoning, but the sense is shouting out to someone, as when flagging a taxi.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: shouting a greeting or summons to someone.

entries.clue: Marsh lying around one desert (4)

indicatorNotes.lying around: lying the other way round, so the word is turned back to front

annotation.surface: A marsh sits beside a lone desert.
annotation.walkthrough: "Around" looks like a container signal, but it turns the marsh round rather than wrapping the I.
annotation.definitionFit: A definition by example: the great desert of Mongolia and northern China.

entries.clue: Alongside wife, I principally trust husband (4)

indicatorNotes.principally: take the principal, meaning first, letter

annotation.surface: A spouse declares trust in her husband above all.
annotation.walkthrough: "Principally" reads as "mainly" in the surface, but it takes only the first letter of trust.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: both mean in the company of, as in walking beside someone.

entries.clue: Our group would shortly sound a bell for celebration (7)

indicatorNotes.shortly: use the shortened form, the contraction

blocks.note: we would shortened with an apostrophe

annotation.surface: We would soon ring bells in celebration.
annotation.walkthrough: "Shortly" reads as "soon" but asks for a contraction. Ringing bells suits the answer, as church bells ring after a marriage.
annotation.definitionFit: A definition by example: a marriage ceremony and party is one kind of celebration.

entries.clue: Behave better in religious education class (6)

blocks.note: RE is the school subject Religious Education
a form is a school class

annotation.surface: A pupil learns to behave in the RE lesson.
annotation.walkthrough: RE is religious education, a school subject in Britain; a form is a British school year group or class.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: to mend one's ways, as a former offender does.

entries.clue: Compulsive fan did act strangely (6)

indicatorNotes.strangely: the letters appear in a strange order

annotation.surface: An obsessive fan behaved oddly.
annotation.walkthrough: The surface is a complete little story, so "strangely" passes as description rather than instruction.
annotation.definitionFit: A loose sense: beyond drug dependency, the word is used of anyone hooked on a hobby, such as a football fanatic.

entries.clue: Cook in right oven (5)

blocks.note: an oast is a kiln for drying hops

annotation.surface: An instruction to cook something in the correct oven.
annotation.walkthrough: An oast is the kiln used to dry hops for brewing, often in a cone-roofed oast house in Kent.
annotation.definitionFit: A specific way to cook: with dry heat in an oven.

entries.clue: Cover plot, badly parsed (9)

indicatorNotes.badly: the letters are badly placed, so rearrange them

annotation.surface: A writer covers up a storyline that was poorly analysed.
annotation.walkthrough: "Plot" suggests a story, but it is a flower bed.
annotation.definitionFit: A definition by example: a decorative top layer laid over a bed is one kind of cover.

entries.clue: Fruit cordial ultimately a greyish colour (5)

indicatorNotes.ultimately: take the ultimate, meaning last, letter

annotation.surface: A fruit squash that ends up an unappetising grey.
annotation.walkthrough: "Fruit cordial" reads as one drink, but the fruit and the cordial split into separate pieces.
annotation.definitionFit: A colour named after a gem: the pale, lustrous grey-white of an oyster's pearl.

entries.clue: Central heating fixture beginning to burn fuel engineer’s jacket (6)

indicatorNotes.beginning to: the beginning of a word is its first letter
indicatorNotes.jacket: a jacket is the outside, so take the outer letters

annotation.surface: An engineer checks that the central heating burns fuel properly.
annotation.walkthrough: "Jacket" is not clothing; it is the outer layer of engineer.
annotation.definitionFit: A definition by function: the unit that heats water for a central heating system.

entries.clue: European capital excitedly into pasta (8)

indicatorNotes.excitedly: excited letters jump about into a new order

blocks.note: Riga is the capital of Latvia

annotation.surface: A traveller in a European capital is eagerly tucking into pasta.
annotation.walkthrough: "Into" looks like a container signal, but it is the anagram fodder.
annotation.definitionFit: A definition by example: ridged tube-shaped pasta.

entries.clue: Picked up teams for voyage at sea (6)

indicatorNotes.Picked up: picked up as by a microphone or ear, so it is how the word sounds

annotation.surface: Crews are collected to go on a sea trip.
annotation.walkthrough: Crews fits the sea scene, but here it only supplies the sound.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: a pleasure trip by ship.

entries.clue: I get mail edited for specific restriction (3,5)

annotation.surface: Someone's post is censored to meet a particular rule.
annotation.walkthrough: "Edited" fits the surface about censored post, which hides that it is the anagram signal.
annotation.definitionFit: A definition by example: a rule barring people above or below a set number of years is one specific restriction.
